_doc: OD-1106-ROBOTS-AI: VERA-DAR is an AI assistant. A site is blocked when robots.txt disallows the path for any agent token below (robots_ai_agent_block) or states in a comment that AI crawlers/assistants are blocked (robots_ai_statement). ROBOTS-TIGHTEN-1108: a group naming ANY own_tokens product token binds every VERA+ route (all matching groups must allow). usage_tokens map a usage-purpose token to an informational signal (never blocks, no * fallback). Applies in addition to VERA-DAR's own group and *. Fails closed.
ai_statement_phrases: ai crawlers and assistants are blocked
ai crawlers and assistants are not permitted
